headline: ARI @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 2.95 at SEA 3.02, with a projected total of 5.97. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: ARI moved -0.69 runs while SEA moved -1.24, changing the projected margin by +0.55 runs. The projected total fell -1.94, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Ryne Nelson has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ketel Marte, Julio Rodríguez, Corbin Carroll, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Barrosa, Rob Refsnyder because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
